scope_notes: Research only: no game implementation, installation, or Start menu change. Control Panel work remains the primary task.
No leaked Microsoft NT/XP source was used. A port’s open-source license does not grant redistribution rights to original proprietary assets.
Candidate ports were not built, run, or accepted for visual fidelity in this task.
This English product-family inventory does not establish every OEM, localized, prerelease, service-pack, XP Starter/Embedded, x64, or IA-64 SKU.
Screensavers, creative applications, and trailer-only sampler entries are excluded from game counts. Retail Entertainment Packs are separate from stock Windows.
No dedicated Plus! for Windows 3.x or Plus! for Windows Me product was confirmed. Plus! for Kids is a Windows 95-era product, not a separate Plus! 98 for Kids release.
Known name traps are recorded: Golf solitaire/Fuji Golf/Golf 1998 Lite; Space Cadet/Pinball Arcade; SegaSoft Lose Your Marbles/the unrelated Macintosh game; Best of Windows/Game Boy Color rosters.

port_candidates.assessment: Native Linux SDL2 decompilation/port; original data files are required and are not included. Highest-priority port candidate. Validate Plus! 95 versus XP data, physics and frame behavior before adoption.
Portable Python solitaire rules and many variants. Its modern Tk/Kivy UI does not match Windows 95. Check deal numbering and scoring before reuse.
Potential solitaire rules reference. GitLab returned HTTP 406; no dependency or license acceptance is claimed.
Clean-room Windows-compatible project. Its Win32 games may supply rules/reference implementations but are not Linux GTK drop-ins. Do not use leaked NT/XP source forks.
Existing Win95LX Minesweeper; not independently audited for rules or pixel fidelity in this inventory.

Replacement server and client-routing project, not a Linux native client. Requires original game clients plus Wine/compatibility or a rewritten client. Multiplayer/bot coverage varies by game. No deployment performed.
Native Linux Reversi analogue. Original Windows artwork, menus, AI difficulty and rules still need comparison; this is not a drop-in fidelity port.
Tile World rules implementation. The reviewed repository is a handheld port; trace the desktop upstream before adopting. Microsoft level data/art and community levels have separate terms.

port_candidates.license_observed: author-provided free binary; no source license verified
port_candidates.assessment: Original author offers SkiFree 1.04 for Win32 and states Wine compatibility. This differs from the 1991 version and is not an open-source native Linux port.
Java 17+ from-scratch implementation claim. Missing explicit licensing and asset provenance mean it is not approved for reuse.

port_candidates.license_observed: GPL-2.0-or-later per project; asset exceptions require review
port_candidates.assessment: Native Linux tilt-ball engine analogue only. It is not The Labyrinth Plus! Edition or Microsoft Golf 1998 Lite; game mechanics, levels and UI differ.
Native C static-recompilation tooling; bring original Hover! files. Small, recent project with unvalidated stability/fidelity. Do not confuse it with the unrelated shurcooL/Hover game from 2000.
